title: prepare to migrate boil.py to golang
description: I want basic unit and integration tests for the 'boil' command so that we can write boil.py to boil.go and the tests will still be valid. The best starting point would be tests/test_example_repos.py since it is a pretty good integration test. I also want to make sure we have coverage for 'boil --check' and 'boil --abort' and 'boil --finish', but i dont think those tests exist. To be clear: dont write any golang yet. Just add more tests that cover the 'boil' executable in a python-agnostic way (so we can seamlessly switch to golang later for the implementation)

description: read all the notes/, create a summary.txt, then delete the rest

title: fix_with_claude.sh should be a boil subcommand
description: I want to say 'boil --fix=claude' and have it do the functionality of the fix_with_claude.sh script. also move to src/ while you're at it!

title: convert src_repair.py to use tree_print for python
description: src_repair.py uses the built-in ast module to parse python code. But for c, we use tree_print instead. This will make porting src_repair.py difficult, so i want both python and c parsing to use tree_print

title: add a src/tools directory and move scripts to it
description: restore_one_line.py, src_repair.py, src_remove.py, print-tree etc should all move (and update references)

title: improve AGENTS.md

title: make identify_removable.py a subcommand of boil
description: the identify_removeable.py script has a few deps in this repo. I want to make it a subcommand of boil.py and move it and all its deps into src/

description: create linux install support, putting boil and tree_print on the PATH

title: create golang implementation of boil.py
description: I want to be able to compile a new 'boil' executable and make it a drop-in replacement such that unit tests that subprocess to 'boil' still pass. You can assume tree_print exists (no need to port that yet) but all the python code should get ported

title: move boil.py and pipeline to a new src/ directory
description:
Creating a src/ folder distinct from the tests/ folder will allow us
to play with file permissions such that src editors can be blocked from editing tests, and vice-versa

it will also clean up the root of the repo.

please move boil.py and all it's dependencies into src/

the tests/ dir is allowed to import from src/
src/ is not allowed to import from test
neither should import from the root of the repo.

title: 'boil --soft' and 'boil --hard' should only modify/delete files that are tracked in git
description: Also, any git commands should be imported to git_ops.py  I'm worried about deleting untracked and hidden files accidentally, so make sure boiler only ever directly edits tracked files

title: identify_removable.py and its depends should import each other instead of using subprocess
description: tree_print should be the only subprocess call. everything else should be an import

title: convert detectors to be defined in json instead of python
description: python is too tempting to use more complicated turing-complete logic. Forcing json will force data driven detectors. Also, it will allow creating new detectors on the fly without rebuilding boil

title: create a plan for how to turn planners into a plugins
description: I want AI agents to be able to add new planners (and detectors) outside the boiler/ repo when they are using boil on an external repo. Ideally boil can find plugins in the current working directory and use them in the pipeline at runtime
